caption: The drawing consists of a square section filled with a pattern of black floral motifs against a deep red background. The black elements form intricate designs of large and small flowers, leaves, and curved stems that are densely arranged, with several stems interweaving and spreading diagonally from the top right toward the bottom left and center of the composition. The flowers vary in size and form, with some showing detailed petals and central stamens, while the leaves display serrated edges and vein-like lines. The red background has a slightly textured appearance, and the pattern fills almost the entire square, leaving a narrow border of uncolored space, and is set on a larger, off-white sheet. There are no other objects or figures present in the drawing.
title: Stenciled Table Cover
